data: What is the name of the method with the highest number of corrected errors at an update frequency of 10?

To determine the method with the highest number of corrected errors at an update frequency of 10, I will analyze the graph and the caption provided.

1. The caption indicates that the figure shows errors corrected for different methods plotted against update frequency or enrollment time.
2. The x-axis represents either update frequency or enrollment time, and the y-axis represents the number of corrected errors.
3. At an update frequency of 10, we need to look at the point where the x-axis value is 10.
4. Observing the graph, the blue line labeled "dynamic-oracleCM" appears to have the highest number of corrected errors at an update frequency of 10 compared to the other lines.

Therefore, the method with the highest number of corrected errors at an update frequency of 10 is "dynamic-oracleCM".
